result.topic_en: A table of the seven computed complex roots of the equation x^7 − 28x^4 + 280 + 651.52373i = 0, giving each root in rectangular form and as log r and angle φ, with sums used as checks against the constant term.

methods.what: Numerical determination of all seven complex roots of a trinomial-type equation with complex constant term, each root given in rectangular form
Polar representation of each root by log of modulus and angle, with 'n' marking a negative modulus (angle reduced to below 180°)
Check that the sum of the roots vanishes, since the equation has no x^6 term
Check that the sum of the log moduli of the roots equals the log of the modulus of the constant term
Check that the sum of the root angles equals the argument φ of the constant term
